# appdynamics_synthetic_api_job (Data Source)

Retrieves the full detail of one Synthetic API Monitoring job by application_id + job_id. Use the appdynamics_synthetic_api_jobs data source to discover job_id values. Shares its type name with the managed resource, same as appdynamics_synthetic_web_job.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_synthetic_api_job" "health_check" {
  application_id = 10499
  job_id         = "4af8bead-8ad9-4668-a073-4accf2f48079"
}

output "health_check_schedule" {
  value = data.appdynamics_synthetic_api_job.health_check.schedule_run_configs_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the appdynamics_synthetic_api_application this job is grouped under.
- `job_id` (String) ID of the job to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `api_metadata_json` (String)
- `composable_config_json` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `location_codes` (List of String)
- `performance_criteria_json` (String)
- `schedule_run_configs_json` (String)
- `timeout_seconds` (Number)
- `user_enabled` (Boolean)
- `version` (Number)
